identification_method: named reservoirs matched by nearest PLD polygon to known coordinates and full-pool area; not an authoritative name crosswalk (PLD has no names). Every other lake is unnamed, identified by PLD id and location only.
dropped_reason: no PLD polygon matched both position and plausible area with enough confidence to publish as named
quality_filtering: dropped quality_f==3 (bad); WSE outliers beyond median +/- max(20m, 6*MAD) dropped per lake; area_total aggregated to monthly MAX (not mean) because a single SWOT pass frequently images only part of a large lake — a partial pass can only under-count true extent, never over-count it.
